profile.aboutTitle: Quality is a team habit, not a last step.
about: I'm a QA Engineer with 4.5 years of experience in software testing. At Ding I test across web, iOS and Android, lead regression testing, and own release-level quality, including go/no-go decisions with the development team.

I'm now growing into test automation. I'm learning Playwright with JavaScript, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, API automation and AI-assisted QA, so I can turn the regression work I do today into automated checks. I hold a BSc in Computer Science from Daffodil International University.

experience.title: QA Engineer
points: End-to-end QA across web, iOS and Android: functional, regression and cross-platform testing.
Lead regression testing and maintain the regression suites, reducing regression testing time by 20–30%.
Own release-level quality validation and go/no-go decisions in coordination with the development team.
Perform production testing and post-deployment monitoring. Significantly reduced the production bug rate, with no major production issues since taking ownership of the process.
API testing of user and payment modules with Postman; database validation with MongoDB.
Test beta builds through TestFlight (iOS) and Android beta channels; use Google Firebase for release distribution, monitoring and crash reporting.
Coordinate deployments with Octopus Deploy and Jenkins CI/CD; support A/B testing by validating feature variants and tracking accuracy.
Manage test cases in TestRail and defects in Kanbanize; review requirements and acceptance criteria; take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement and release planning.
Learning Playwright (JavaScript) for UI and API automation, to support future automated regression testing.
